runtimeMapping.trait: Idle Default retains selected DEF percentage and RES additive modifiers and cannot attack. Active S1/S2/S3 overrides those defensive modifiers.
runtimeMapping.s1: Infinite toggle with selected additive BAT, ATK and per-hit slow. Original Skill_1_Begin/End and Skill_1_Loop .4 hit with native max-scale1.
runtimeMapping.s2: Selected ASPD and taunt, duration25; original eventless Skill_2_Loop continues while local direct all-target attacks release with zero windup. Ally talent is granted on entry, retained on exit, removed on detach; original profession mask excludes TOKEN/TRAP.
runtimeMapping.s3: Selected ATK and expanded range. Only barrier value is multiplied by talent_scale. Seeded uniform choice among original Skill_3_Attack_A/B/C, each .333 hit and source max-scale1. Attack-only kill creates original .2s refresh; at finish a broken barrier reforms, or a ready barrier emits an expanded blast without entering cooldown.
runtimeMapping.barrier: Fixed resistance after DEF/RES and before ordinary shields. The local BlockDamage mapping subtracts selected value from each accepted receipt; strict positive overflow (source dynamic<0) breaks and passes excess HP damage. No accumulated barrier pool; selected interval owns reform time across modes. Local blast centres on protected recipient; S3 owner blasts use expanded skill range. Stun precedes Arts damage; shatter is not an Attack ability and cannot trigger S3 kill refresh.
runtimeMapping.t2: Selected probability and SP, including zero HP damage after block. Native IsIgnoreForSp and ordinary active-skill/noSp gates are retained; direct HP loss and elemental gauge are excluded.
runtimeMapping.lifecycle: Source-owned recipient state is scoped to deployment sequence; death/withdrawal cleans grants and invalidates pending refresh/transition. Entering/leaving skill modes does not clear an existing self-barrier cooldown.

verificationLimits: No native C# BlockDamage implementation is recovered. Subtractive overflow, strict equality from dynamic<0 versus translated >= text, damageFinal priority1000, mitigation/ordinary-shield order and overlapping independent barriers are bounded local policies, not recorded-client/frame parity.

S2 waits for an attack event in its native ability but its empty animation key and literal Skill_2_Loop have no hit event. Zero-windup dispatch is a disclosed local bridge; exact native attack-event scheduling remains unrecovered.

Ally shatter origin at the protected recipient, source Lin ATK basis and same-tick stun-before-damage dispatch are explicit mappings of the original selector and buff source/owner fields, not independently executed Unity code.
Original S3 .2s refresh lifetime is recovered; native late-enable phase ordering versus local 30Hz callbacks and same-frame multikill/coincident reform ordering remain unverified.
Original aliases and hit clocks are retained; seeded uniform S3 A/B/C selection is local because native animation randomization/playlist dispatch is not recovered.
Actual model bytes are verified and already published at the existing SD pin. Original Unity barrier/shatter/skill particle materials, audio, modules and game-frame parity remain unfinished.
